notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
A few minor improvements have been added and some minor BUGS fixed.

Furthermore, it was reported that the first checkpoint sometimes did not work since patch 1.1, this has now been fixed.

notes.title: Update V1.1 - Bonus level, more story in loading screens, achievements, collectables, new language, secret cheatcode, SALE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/1742051eaabac7c4d42b216e765249c9888e5f78.png[/img]


Hello everyone,
the first big update for E06 - Anomaly is ready.



[h1][b]Achievements  [/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/6062a287ec72e3ab0a9cfc83302e3de9a1647fb0.png[/img]

You can now achieve up to 15 achievements. Seven of them for collecting green arrows which are hidden in each level or difficult to reach.

[b][h1]Collectables[/h1][/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/ee35824f0b109639363b2ed264142263e4784427.png[/img]

Collect four of these green arrows to unlock the bonus level.

[b][h1]Bonus level[/h1][/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/53da4515e0f246dbea93fd1d5f2840238cedf00c.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/df437b07e7b2f022a72ac7d4fe71a79234fced7f.png[/img]

The bonus level is a big puzzle which is very difficult to solve. Just right for all puzzle lovers.

The bonus level will appear in the main menu after collecting four green arrows.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/f433f40c6cf502d8105eeef4249091fd00fc644d.png[/img]

[b][h1]Loading screens[/h1][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/c3b86663a765544e47face1085e5181c3b62f673.jpg[/img]

Additional location information has been embedded in the loading screens.

[b][h1]New language: Portuguese Brasil[/h1][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/ade657e5a0bed03d47cd098f54d6ec7d0f8df2e6.jpg[/img]


Thanks to Zake Kuerten, there is now a new language.

[b][h1]Secret cheatcode[/h1][/b]

In three level there are secret letters you have to find. 
If you enter these three letters in a row, the secret cheatcode will be unlocked, which will make your energy arrow extremely powerful.


[b][h1]Updates[/h1][/b]

If, despite many tests, problems with the game occur, I will of course immediately provide further updates and fixes.


[b][h1]SALE[/h1][/b]

From 10.08.2019 the first SALE will take place with 35% discount.


[b][h1]I wish you much fun playing E06 - Anomaly[/h1][/b]

notes.title: Archivment just for testing
notes.content:
You can not unlock the archivment yet. 
There are only for testing for the first major update.

notes.title: Not spawning spiders and giants issue fixed
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Spiders who have not appeared appear now

[*] An intermediate boss spawns now always

[*] The first switch is now lit so that not everyone overlooks him - that was not meant to be that way

[*] The loading image of one level was removed before the end of the loading process - this is no longer the case
[/list]

notes.content:

Aro Games

The "Y" BUG has been fixed

Have fun playing.

notes.title: The "Y-Bug"
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

currently there is still a small BUG you can avoid if you do not press "Y" on your keyboard.

He sets your number of arrows to 100 and saves the game so that the next time you load you will be in the last level.

A patch is already on the way.

We apologize and if you find BUGS, please contact us and we'll try our best to fix it.
